purpose: Bind retained QDP runtime rules to explicit enforcement surfaces so prose governance cannot drift away from executable behavior.

rules.title: No loss preservation for execution bearing runtime text
rules.required_behavior: No future runtime assembly may replace detailed operational sections with shorthand references to prior versions.

enforcement_bindings.implementation: runtime/current/runtime_prompt.md must contain full retained sections explicitly
modules/m06_bootstrap_harness/runner.py checks runtime prompt presence, forbidden shorthand, and mandatory retained section presence when the runtime artifact exists

rules.title: Authoritative runtime is additive composition, not summary substitution
rules.required_behavior: The authoritative runtime equals retained v10.1 operative text plus deterministic control patches plus harness plus diagnostics plus post run validation plus typed self checks.

enforcement_bindings.implementation: runtime/current/runtime_prompt.md assembly process
Patch notes and closure report inspection

rules.title: Strict reference resolution for retained and canonical references
rules.required_behavior: All critical retained references must resolve in strict mode for ordinary and subsystem execution paths.

enforcement_bindings.implementation: modules/m03_reference_resolution/runner.py
modules/m06_bootstrap_harness/runner.py executes strict ordinary/subsystem reference-resolution and records failure in governance self check

rules.title: Post run schema validation is mandatory
rules.required_behavior: Candidate outputs must validate against the current schema after stage machine execution.

enforcement_bindings.implementation: tools/validators/candidate_validator.py against config/schema/candidate_schema.json
modules/m05_stage_machine/runner.py self test pipeline validates emitted candidates

rules.title: Validation ladder state must be explicit and monotone
rules.required_behavior: Outputs must emit explicit ladder states and termination points rather than implied progress.

enforcement_bindings.implementation: modules/m05_stage_machine/runner.py emits validation_ladder and terminated_at fields
config/schema/candidate_schema.json requires system status fields consumed by stage machine

rules.title: Null model and baseline sufficiency take priority over Hamiltonian expansion
rules.required_behavior: A branch that is explained by the baseline or fails reduction checks must terminate before promotion logic.

enforcement_bindings.implementation: modules/m05_stage_machine/runner.py baseline sufficiency termination at Stage 6 in self tests
Baseline model adequacy still depends on future M08 quantitative suite

rules.title: Every candidate must carry an explicit falsifier
rules.required_behavior: Branches cannot advance without a concrete falsifier tied to measurable observables.

enforcement_bindings.implementation: Retained runtime text and manual report review
Future M06 or M12 should fail candidates missing exact_falsifier

rules.title: Cross device evidence governs promotion ceiling
rules.required_behavior: Without confirmed cross device evidence the branch cannot be promoted beyond sandbox or provisional status.

enforcement_bindings.implementation: modules/m05_stage_machine/runner.py clips provisional results to SANDBOX_ONLY absent confirmed cross device status
config/schema/candidate_schema.json includes cross_device_status

rules.title: Governance self diagnostic fields must be emitted
rules.required_behavior: Outputs must include governance_self_check and typed status fields sufficient for deterministic audit.

enforcement_bindings.implementation: config/schema/candidate_schema.json
modules/m06_bootstrap_harness/runner.py verifies governance_self_check field presence and mirror consistency across bootstrap outputs

rules.title: Ordinary and subsystem modes share an immutable core unless explicit delta is declared
rules.required_behavior: Mode specific logic may extend but not silently override shared core references, fields, or stage order.

enforcement_bindings.implementation: Current resolver emits by mode summaries only
modules/m06_bootstrap_harness/runner.py emits artifacts/reports/system/mode_divergence_report.json and fails if shared core fields diverge without exception

coverage_summary.note: Coverage summary counts terminal coverage_status values after M06 harness integration.
